title: Intent-Driven Dynamic Chunking: Segmenting Documents to Reflect Predicted Information Needs
abstract: arXiv:2602.14784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Breaking long documents into smaller segments is a fundamental challenge in information retrieval. Whether for search engines, question-answering systems, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), effective segmentation determines how well systems can locate and return relevant information. However, traditional methods, such as fixed-length or coherence-based segmentation, ignore user intent, leading to chunks that split answers or contain irrelevant noise. We introduce Intent-Driven Dynamic Chunking (IDC), a novel approach that uses predicted user queries to guide document segmentation. IDC leverages a Large Language Model to generate likely user intents for a document and then employs a dynamic programming algorithm to find the globally optimal chunk boundaries. This represents a novel application of DP to intent-aware segmentation that avoids greedy pitfalls. We evaluated IDC on six diverse question-answering datasets, including news

translated_title: 意图驱动的动态分块：根据预测的信息需求分割文档
translated_abstract: 将长文档分割成较小的片段是信息检索中的一个基本挑战。无论是搜索引擎、问答系统还是检索增强生成（RAG），有效的分割决定了系统定位和返回相关信息的能力。然而，传统方法，如固定长度或基于连贯性的分割，忽略了用户意图，导致分块分割答案或包含无关噪声。我们引入了意图驱动的动态分块（IDC），一种新颖的方法，利用预测的用户查询来指导文档分割。IDC利用大型语言模型生成文档可能的用户意图，然后采用动态规划算法找到全局最优的分块边界。这代表了动态规划在意图感知分割中的新颖应用，避免了贪婪算法的陷阱。我们在六个多样化的问答数据集上评估了IDC，包括新闻数据。
tldr: 提出了一种基于预测用户意图的动态分块方法，利用大型语言模型和动态规划算法实现全局最优的文档分割，显著优于传统固定长度或连贯性方法。
en_tdlr: Introduces Intent-Driven Dynamic Chunking, a novel approach that uses predicted user intents and dynamic programming to achieve globally optimal document segmentation, outperforming traditional fixed-length or coherence-based methods.
